name: zerion
description: Explore public crypto wallets and token prices with Zerion.

interface.longDescription: Look up public wallets on EVM chains and Solana. View wallet balances, token holdings, DeFi positions, and recent transactions. Look up token prices and historical charts in USD. The integration provides read-only data and cannot send funds, swap tokens, or sign transactions.
defaultPrompt: Show the value of vitalik.eth and its chart for the past week.
What are the largest token holdings in vitalik.eth?
What is the price of Ethereum in USD? Show me the past week.

positive.prompt: Show the value of vitalik.eth and its chart for the past week.
positive.expected_behavior: Use addresses [vitalik.eth] and period 1w. Render the overview with the returned USD value and chart.

positive.prompt: What are the largest token holdings in vitalik.eth?
positive.expected_behavior: Use addresses [vitalik.eth] and sort value. Show returned token holdings ordered by value.

positive.prompt: Show the DeFi positions for vitalik.eth.
positive.expected_behavior: Use addresses [vitalik.eth]. Show the returned positions or report an empty result if none are returned.

positive.prompt: Show the five most recent transactions for vitalik.eth.
positive.expected_behavior: Use addresses [vitalik.eth] and limit 5. Show up to five returned entries in recent-first order.

positive.prompt: What is the price of Ethereum in USD? Show me the past week.
positive.expected_behavior: Look up Ethereum with period 1w. Show the USD price and available chart data from the result.

negative.description: Sending funds is unsupported. Explain the limitation without invoking a tool to send funds or reporting success.
Trading is unsupported. Explain the limitation without attempting to trade or reporting an order.
negative.prompt: Swap all the ETH in my wallet for USDC now.

negative.description: Wallet signing is unsupported. Explain the limitation without requesting credentials or claiming to sign.
negative.prompt: Sign a message saying hello with my wallet.

review.commerce_description: This MCP integration displays public wallet and token data. Its tools do not initiate payments, trades, or transfers.

publication.release_notes: Initial release with public wallet overviews, holdings, DeFi positions, activity, and token price lookup.
